fonts.display: 'Reckless Neue', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Saans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Primary Indigo
palette.role: Primary action buttons, active nav state, icon accents — the single saturated focal color that makes CTAs unmistakably interactive

palette.name: Deep Ink
palette.role: Headlines, body text, primary borders — near-black violet that pairs warmth with the serif typeface

palette.name: Midnight Violet
palette.role: Navigation borders, secondary surfaces, gradient terminus — darker sibling to Primary Indigo for layered depth

palette.name: Forest
palette.role: Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

palette.name: Ember
palette.role: Tinted card surfaces, portrait frame backgrounds — warm orange that signals energy and human warmth

palette.name: Blossom
palette.role: Tinted feature card backgrounds, hero photo frame — mid-pink for category-coded surfaces

palette.name: Petal
palette.role: Light pink surface washes and button backgrounds — lightest tint in the pink family for soft fills

palette.name: Meadow
palette.role: Dark green button background variant — deep saturated green for contrasting pill buttons

palette.name: Lavender Mist
palette.role: Outlined/ghost button borders, subtle violet washes — soft tint version of Primary Indigo

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: Page canvas, section backgrounds, link surfaces — the warm off-white base layer that defines the entire mood

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Link and icon text — slightly lighter than pure black for secondary text

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card surfaces, button text, inverted elements — the clean surface that sits on top of cream

palette.name: True Black
palette.role: Primary text, maximum-contrast borders, heading strokes

palette.name: Info Blue
palette.role: Badge backgrounds for informational tags — near-gray blue for low-emphasis status indicators
